out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no “employees must wash hands” sign in the downstairs restroom.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. The manager corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: salsa was 54º, commercial kimchi was 55º, hot dogs were 56º, and guacamole was 53º in the Everest 2-door prep refrigerator in the upstairs kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. The manager discarded all the foods listed above. CDI.

violations.title: Air/Water Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The ambient (air/water) temperature measuring device located in the following unit is not accurate in degrees F. The thermometer in the Everest 2-door unit was not accurate. It was reading 40ºF at all times, but the actual temperature of the unit was 55ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Ambient air and water temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/-3 degrees F in the intended range of use. The manager replaced the inaccurate thermometer with an accurate one during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard was being used to line one of the shelving units in the first floor storage area.
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. The manager removed the cardboard during the inspection to correct. CDI.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the Everest 2-door unit on the second floor was not working properly.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Please have the unit serviced and notify the EHS when it is working correctly.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: The backflow or backsiphonage prevention device installed on the first floor mop sink is not identified as meeting standards set by the American Society of Sanitary Engineering. A hose Bibb splitter was installed on the faucet which is equipped with an atmospheric vacuum breaker.
violations.corrective_action: A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. The EHS shared an example of an approved splitter/backflow prevention device for this application: a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve. The manager removed the unapproved splitter during the inspection to correct and will order and install the correct device. CDI.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. The mop head was left lying in the mopsink basin.
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. The manager corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. Follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: pico de gallo (2/23), kimchi (3/5) in 2 dr prep unit at expo of main kitchen; caramelized onion (2/16), pizza sauce (2/24) in 2 dr prep unit in main kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. PIC discarded all items exceeding the 7 day shelf life.
